whole_current_roster.title: Bruton's Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor (BI705564) for Canine B-Cell Lymphoma
whole_current_roster.eligibilitySummary: Dogs aged >1 year, weighing 10-50 kg, with newly diagnosed, untreated B-cell lymphoma confirmed by cytology/histology with immunophenotyping, with at least two peripheral lymph nodes ≥2 cm and WHO stage II, III, or IV disease.
whole_current_roster.eligibilityDetails: Dogs >1 year old and 10-50 kg in body weight; Naïve, untreated B-cell lymphoma confirmed by cytology or histology with immunophenotyping (flow cytometry); At least two peripheral lymph nodes ≥2 cm in longest diameter; WHO stage II, III, or IV B-cell lymphoma; Adequate organ function on bloodwork and urinalysis; Performance score of 0-1 (normal to mildly decreased activity) and life expectancy ≥1 month; Owner consent. Key exclusions: T-cell lymphoma or involvement of skin, GI tract, or nervous system; Internal-only disease (mediastinum, liver, spleen) without peripheral lymph node enlargement; Prior lymphoma treatment (chemotherapy, Tanovea, Laverdia, radiation) or long-term corticosteroids (>2 weeks); Hypercalcemia, MDR1 deficiency, pregnancy/lactation, or concurrent trial enrollment.
